title: Report On Liubooshkin

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Central Station,
No. I. O. D. 817.
Date December 24, 1929.
Subject (in full) V.I. Liubooshkin.
Made by D.S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by Jh Robertson C.I.D.
Inquiries show that V.I. Liubooshkin is a Cossack of
Orenburg Province, and arrived in China in 1922 among the
ranks of White Russian Army after its defeat in the Maritime
Province in the same year. In 1924 he joined the Chinese
army and served for two years when he suddenly and mysteriously
became possessed of money with which he opened a gambling den
known as the International Club at Tsinanfu. It is also
reported that while he was proprietor of the latter business
he acted as a receiver of stolen property. In 1928 he
arrived in Tsingtao and in the following year was forced to
leave for Shanghai owing to his being afraid that certain
dealings he had in counterfeit money had become known to the
Police. While in Tsingtao he also continued to act as agent
for Mr. Dobrovolsky, Soviet Commercial Attaché, whom he met
in Tsinanfu. Since his arrival in Shanghai he has been in
close touch with two criminals named Marcevich who resides in
the French Concession and Timorkin whose name is included in
the list of Soviet Representatives in China recently received
from the President of the Shanghai Provisional Court. Inquiries
re: Liubooshkin at the Cossack's Union corroborate the above
and learn that the Union do not recommend him as a person
fitted to undertake employment in Shanghai.
B. Maklaevsky 3/1
D. S.
H.R.
24/12/29.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告
档案号
上海公共租界工部局警务处
中央捕房，
编号 I. O. D. 817。
日期 1929年12月24日。
事由（全称） V.I. Liubooshkin。
制作人 D.S. Maklaevsky。由刑事侦缉处 Jh Robertson 转呈。
调查显示，V.I. Liubooshkin 系奥伦堡省哥萨克人，于1922年随白俄军队在同年滨海边疆区战败后抵达中国。1924年他加入中国军队，服役两年期间，突然且神秘地获得一笔资金，并在济南府开设了一家名为“国际俱乐部”的赌场。另有报告称，他在经营该生意期间充当赃物接收者。1928年他抵达青岛，次年因担心其涉及伪钞的交易已被警方知晓，被迫前往上海。在青岛期间，他还继续担任苏联商务参赞 Dobrovolsky 先生的代理人，二人相识于济南府。自抵达上海以来，他与两名罪犯保持密切联系，分别是居住于法租界的 Marcevich，以及 Timorkin，后者的名字列入最近从上海临时法院院长处收到的在华苏联代表名单中。就 Liubooshkin 一事向哥萨克联盟进行的查询证实了上述情况，并获悉该联盟不推荐他作为适合在上海受雇的人员。
B. Maklaevsky 3/1
D. S.
H.R.
29/12/24.
